availability: Whole score week eligible only if LAST scheduled game kickoff+7days is strictly before earliest current-week fitting origin. No next-week or partial-current-week scores.
exposure: All years exposed; chronological reconstruction using current/revised football source versions under assumed7-day availability. No original issuance or fresh holdout.
fit_history: All forecasts H-MULTI, expanding from2022 with common older feature memory; current score-memory is method-selection evidence, not strict-current football information.
lineage: Same v2 algorithm with season-relative prior/current names; not a new learner. 2026 aliases FROZEN_2025_BEST / EARLIER_AVAILABLE_2026_SCORE_MEMORY / POOLED_2025_AND_AVAILABLE_2026_MEMORY retain original identities/scores.
mask_rule: Every recipe/week must equal base query identities, supported-label identities AND values; compare exact sets before policy metrics.
startup: Base Leaf-CDF H-MULTI median/event_probability, as registered v2; no hidden historical fallback purity claim.
